reuse.why: Expresses the rule through the existing recurrence builder recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule's byDayOfWeek support, which every schedule path already uses.

duplication.why: A three-line change in one function; no logic copied.

placement.why: Recurrence generation in shared/schedules.ts is a natural home, though it folds a weekend-handling setting into the raw occurrence set that callers like getNextDate(noSkipWeekend) treat as unadjusted.

scope.why: Only the rule, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Minimal and declarative; a maintainer has to know that for daily schedules weekend handling now lives in rule generation rather than alongside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts recurConfigToRSchedule daily case, consumed by parseRecurDate (getNextDate), schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and find-schedules.ts.
